identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of exa-cel in Subjects With Severe Sickle Cell Disease

descriptionModule.briefSummary: A single-arm, open-label, multi-site study evaluating exagamglogene autotemcel (exa-cel) in subjects with severe sickle cell disease.

identificationModule.briefTitle: Long-term Follow-up Study of exa-cel in Subjects With Sickle Cell Disease or Beta-Thalassemia

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Long-term follow-up of subjects who received exa-cel in a prior study.
